title: Bartsch's Open Letter to Kepler, 1628
author: Jacob Bartsch
summary: Bartsch dedicates the first ephemeris computed from the *Rudolphine Tables* to the University of Strasbourg, and in an open letter tells Kepler how he came to compute it with the new logarithmic method, and of his plans for 'practical spheres' that would show the planetary motions to the eye.

notes.on: Mathematician to three Emperors in turn
notes.note: Rudolf II, Matthias and Ferdinand II.
Julius Schiller's *Coelum stellatum christianum* (Augsburg, 1627), which renamed the constellations after Christian figures; Bartsch saw it through the press after Schiller's death.
